experiment.topic: BTC-USD 1-hour return mean-reversion under 30-period moving average deviation threshold
experiment.hypothesis: BTC-USD 1-hour returns exhibit mean-reversion when price deviates more than 4% from a 30-period moving average, with a statistically significant return toward the moving average within the next 1-2 hours.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: Over a 2020-2026 period, if BTC-USD 1-hour returns show no mean-reversion when price deviates more than 4% from a 30-period moving average, and instead exhibit persistent momentum or random walk behavior, the hypothesis is falsified.
